description: Reverse-ETL sink: sync a computed cohort into a LaunchDarkly segment's target list via a semantic patch, adding or removing context keys per row.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row adds or removes one context key from a LaunchDarkly segment.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_added / rows_removed / rows_errored). No downstream data -- write side effect lands in LaunchDarkly.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

context_key_column.label: Context Key Column
context_key_column.description: Upstream column holding the context key to add/remove.

in_segment_column.label: In Segment Column
in_segment_column.description: Upstream boolean-ish column: if false, that row's key is removed instead of added. If unset, every row is added.

context_kind.label: Context Kind
context_kind.description: LaunchDarkly context kind these keys belong to.

max_rows.label: Max Rows
max_rows.description: Overall safety cap on rows per run.

name: LaunchDarkly Segment Update
